name: M Master Deck Build Box Power Style

releases.name: M Master Deck Build Box Power Style

description.text: The Power Style box of the M Master Deck Build Boxes, two boxes released together on 7 August 2015. Each held 203 cards of 58 kinds, all non-holo reprints: 102 of the most important cards of the XY series up to Gaia Volcano and Tidal Storm, chosen by top players and including 14 Pokémon-EX, and 101 basic Energy of all nine types. The Power Style box goes for heavy damage, with the cards for a Fighting deck around Primal Groudon-EX and a Psychic deck around M Gengar-EX, plus Charizard-EX, Korrina and Strong Energy; the Speed Style box goes for speed. A strategy book gave five example decks, and the long box holds up to 750 cards.
